description: Connection setup + single request cost. Isolates connection establishment overhead from connection reuse. Each iteration: fresh connection -> single request -> close. Measures TCP connect latency, TTFB, and total request duration.
loopback_caveat: Cold-connect loopback measurements reflect kernel TCP stack cost without network RTT. Results are NOT comparable to measurements with network path. H1 result artifacts must use transport_mode=loopback-h1; H2 result artifacts must use transport_mode=loopback-h2c.

concurrency.note: Single connection per iteration by design. VU count is not persistent connection count.

h1.mechanism: Connection: close header forces fresh TCP connection per request

h2.note: True per-connection isolation requires external loop; h2load does not natively reconnect per request

h3.reason: H3/QUIC cold-connect requires dedicated QUIC toolchain (xk6-quic, h3load, or curl --http3 loop). No confirmed driver in runtime/drivers.

comparison_axis_note: Within-protocol only. Do not compare H1 cold-connect latency to H2 cold-connect latency without explicit protocol-overhead caveat — they measure different handshake stacks.
